title: SALAV X3 Commercial Full-Sized Garment Steamer
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B09NQL18N3 is the navy SALAV X3 (X3-NAVY), UPC 810074610292.

comparisons.notes: Live manufacturer product data confirms X3-NAVY, UPC 810074610292, one unit and available.

writeup: Woot has a new SALAV X3 commercial full-sized garment steamer in navy for $61.99. This is the X3-NAVY model with a 3-liter tank and foot pedal, matching UPC 810074610292 and ASIN B09NQL18N3. SALAV USA lists the same steamer in stock on its own site for $179.99. That is about 65 percent below the manufacturer's current price and saves roughly $118. Woot showed 1+ left with a limit of one per customer.
